prerequisites: Knowledge form the Mechanics (Theoretical Mechanics) field

learning_outcomes.text: A student can use methods strength of materials methods to analyse information to solve engineering problems, present the results of task, fulfil tasks, use knowledge gained from the subject, and use methods and tools.
The student can analyse a behaviour of mechanical systems, fulfil tasks, use knowledge gained from the subject, use methods and tools, analyse information, and present the results of task.

The student can design simple mechanical systems and conduct mechanical analysis of these systems, assess knowledge contained in presentations, assess factual knowledge, and assess knowledge contained in written work and projects.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of Strength of Materials. Area moments of inertia.
Axial load: statically determinate problems of bars and systems of bars.

Torsion load: statically determinate problems of shafts, driving shafts, statically indeterminate problems shafts.
Bending of beams: determination of shear forces and bending moments.
